name: Prismatic Orb
body:
School evocation [light]; Level sorcerer/wizard 7

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Effect prismatic orb
Duration 1 round/level
Saving Throw see text; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You create a head-sized orb of scintillating colors. Once per round as a free action, the orb can fire a ray of prismatic energy with a range of 50 feet. The ray has a random effect using the table from prismatic spray. To affect a target with the effect, you must succeed at a ranged spell attack using your spellcasting ability modifier instead of Dexterity. The target must then make a save depending upon which color of ray they are affected by. After a particular color has been used by the orb, it is no longer available and must be re-rolled.

Once all the colors are expended, the orb dissipates and the spell ends.

You can move the prismatic orb up to your speed as a move action, but the orb must stay within the range of the spell from you. If you move further than the spell’s range from it, it becomes inactive and cannot be moved until you move closer to it again.

The orb is not tangible and as such cannot be damaged or targeted except by targeted dispel effects and disintegration which instantly destroys the prismatic orb.
